rule: recipe_links.LINK_RULE; preregistered before the archive results for most sites were read
design_sample: 12 recorded links per site, drawn with Python random.Random(1) by probe_links.py; www.epicurious.com's 12 split into its two path patterns
success: the opened page shows the record's title (normalized); hand reads, listed per link, decide renamed recipes (success) and redirects to different recipes (failure)
deviations: Archived copies were not checked for sites whose recorded pages already met the bar, so the rule 'more successes wins' was not applied there; food52.com (10/12) and www.foodnetwork.com (10/12) could in principle have scored higher archived.
Where curl was bot-blocked or challenged, recorded pages were opened in Chromium instead.

www.myrecipes.com's preregistered archive year (2019) failed, 7 of 12; one preregistered second round tried 2021, the latest other year with captures of at least 10 of the 12 design links, on a fresh sample drawn with seed 2. It failed as well, 6 of 12, so the site's records have no link.

www.povarenok.ru passed its design check (12 of 12 recorded pages, September 23), but all 22 of its links in the first held-out check failed on September 24, and its homepage served the site's own outage page. One preregistered recheck on a fresh sample (seed 3) found 0 of 12 recorded pages and 12 of 12 archived copies (2025) showing the recipe, so its cards open the archived copy. The site answered again by 00:57 EDT; a later release can recheck it.
caveats: Each decision rests on about 12 links per site, so a site's true rate can differ from its sample; the held-out checks below measure the shipped links.
A title check can pass a page that is a different recipe with a similar title; hand reads caught two such pages in the design sample (listed).

held_out_checks.links_checked: the v5 index, in which www.povarenok.ru cards opened the recorded page
notes: The Internet Archive refused connections to 7 of the 16 archive links on the first pass; they were re-run once and the re-run stands.
